notes.title: ​Update 1.0.3 and official walkthrough
notes.content:
Dear point and click lovers,

just to inform you all that we just updated the game to version 1.0.3 for both PC and Mac.

With this update we fixed some minor issues on the PC version and we were able to halve the size of the game, increase its stability and optimize the framerate for the Mac version.

[b]About the savegames:
[list]
[*] PC version: savegames between 1.0.2 (last public PC version) and 1.0.3 are compatible.
[*] Mac version: savegames between 1.0.1 (last public Mac version) and 1.0.3 are NOT compatible, but don't worry: you can go back to the previous version at any time and keep the savegames intact! How? Very simple: Right click on "Eselmir and the five magical gifts" on your Steam library. Select "Properties" and select the wished version under the "Betas" tab. In any case, you can then always switch back to the current 1.0.3 public version choosing "NONE - Opt out of all beta programs".[/b][img]https://image.ibb.co/cWsuhx/eselmir103beta.png[/img]

And, last but not least, ​You guys asked for it and here it is: we published the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1335014414]official walkthrough[/url] of the game! It is only in Italian but we think that it should be not a big issue to translate it in English or in any other language with Google Translate. Anyone can feel free to post the translated version of it in the "[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/677850/guides/]Guides[/url]" section of the Community Hub :)

Thank you again for your valued suggestions, feedback and for your interest in our old fashioned point and click adventure game! Feel free to report us any issue: we put our heart and soul in the game and we do care about your game experience! :)

To get more on the latest news follow us on [url=http://www.facebook.com/stelexsoftware]Facebook[/url] or [url=http://www.twitter.com/StelexSoftware]Twitter[/url].

-Stelex Software

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 (public release)
notes.content:
Dear point and click lovers,

after several days of intensive testing we are happy to announce that Eselmir's update v1.0.2, previously on beta, has passed the various tests and is now available as official public update for everyone.

The annoying bugs that afflicted a part of players (invisible characters, crazy mouse cursor, frequent crashes, ...) has been corrected. The upgrade to a newer version of the game engine (Visionaire Studio 4.2.5) also made possible to halve the size of the game, increase its stability and the framerate. Savegames between 1.0.2 "beta" and 1.0.2 "public" are compatible.

[b]Warning: unfortunately the savegames of the previous public version (1.0.1) don't work with the new current version (1.0.2). Don't worry: if you had no problems playing, you can go back to the previous version at any time and keep the savegames intact! How? Very simple: Right click on "Eselmir and the five magical gifts" on your Steam library. Select "Properties". Select "v1.0.1 - Jan 12, 2018" under the "Betas" tab.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/itnRq6v.jpg[/img]

You can then always switch back to the current 1.0.2 public version choosing "NONE - Opt out of all beta programs".

This update concerns only the PC version.

Thank you again for your valued suggestions, feedback and for your interest in our old fashioned point and click adventure game! Feel free to report us any issue: we put our heart and soul in the game and we don't want that you can't appreciate it for some random bugs :)

To get more on the latest news follow us on [url=http://www.facebook.com/stelexsoftware]Facebook[/url] or [url=http://www.twitter.com/StelexSoftware]Twitter[/url].

-Stelex Software

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 (beta)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

thank you for your valued suggestions, feedback and for your interest in our old fashioned point and click adventure game! :)

Thanks to your help we figured out that a lot of random issues that some players are having are caused by the game engine itself. The version we used (Visionaire Studio v3.7) has some bugs that can't be addressed.

So, what we did? We bought the license for the latest version of Visionaire Studio and we already updated and recompiled the game.

Warning: [b]this new version is still beta[/b] but if you had major problems playing the current 1.0.1 build of the game (crashes, invisible characters, crazy mouse, ...) you can already have access to the 1.0.2 version right now! It is also faster and much lighter.

How? Very simple: [b]Right click on "Eselmir and the five magical gifts" on your Steam library. Select "Properties". Select "v1.0.2" under the "Betas" tab.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ui7KGl2.png[/img]

[b]You can always switch back to the current 1.0.1 public version choosing "NONE - Opt out of all beta programs".[/b]

Please take note that unfortunately the current savegames (1.0.1) don't work with the new version (1.0.2) and also that this is going to happen on every update.

This update concerns only the PC version. Of course, if you had no problems you don't need to update the game.

That's it! Feel free to report us any issue.

We put our heart and soul in the game and we don't want that you can't appreciate it for some random bugs :)

To get more on the latest news follow us on [url=http://www.facebook.com/stelexsoftware]Facebook[/url] or [url=http://www.twitter.com/StelexSoftware]Twitter[/url].

-Stelex Software
